title: Launch Gatekeeper: orchestration playbook, sprint schedule, and cross-team cutover lanes
creator: Priya Nair
description: Create a consolidated Launch Gatekeeper playbook that defines sprint-aligned cutover lanes, stakeholder runbooks, and automated signal checks for runtime/console/API releases. Purpose: reduce last-mile coordination drift, lower rollback frequency, and standardize capacity reservations and rollback criteria across Dedicated and Hosted launches.
acceptance_criteria: A single playbook exists in Confluence with versioning and owner list
Sprint-level cutover lanes (Green/Amber/Red) defined with exact gate criteria and automated signals
Preflight checklist integrated with launch calendar (calendar-as-code) and linked to capacity reservations
Rollback & mitigation playbooks with owner roster tested in a dry-run
At least two cross-team dry-runs completed with documented findings and action items
comments: 2026-03-02 Priya Nair: Initial ticket created after ops sync — scope covers runtime, console, and API launches. Goal: reduce interlock meetings by 40% and make rollbacks deterministic.

2026-03-04 Marco Alvarez: Spoke with infra SREs; recommend adding an automated capacity reservation step that creates a temporary quota in Dedicated for the week-of-launch. See draft spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/LAUNCH/Gatekeeper+Draft

2026-03-06 Design review (Anya Kozlov): UX for Launch Console widgets needs two variants — simple signal hub and expanded timeline view. Action: DES to prototype; link: https://drive.redwood.ai/designs/launch-gatekeeper-v1

2026-03-07 Engineering (Liam Chen): Raised edge case where quantization rollouts can change latency distribution mid-window. Trade-off: either tighten gate (longer canary) or accept transient SLA deviations with automated throttles. Proposed: longer canary for model-impacting rollout + circuit-breaker. PR capturing telemetry checks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proposals/pull/112

2026-03-09 PM sync: Agreed on three-lane model (Green/Amber/Red). Amber requires automated rollback trigger if 3 consecutive 5-minute windows breach p95 latency threshold and error rate > 1%. Need SRE to validate thresholds by 2026-03-18.
2026-03-11 Security (Marta Singh): Confirmed no elevated secrets exposure for playbook automation; recommend KMS hook for temporary credentials. Security review scheduled 2026-03-16.

2026-03-12 Marco Alvarez: Added dry-run plan for 2026-03-28 to validate runbooks and paging. Owners: Runtime (Liam), Console (Anya), API (Priya). Deliverables: runbook checklist, postmortem template, capacity reservation automation script.
notes: Runbook sections: preflight (canaries, capacity, telemetry), cutover (signal thresholds, escalation), rollback (criteria, database schema freezes), post-launch (observability smoke checks, cost reconciliation)
Calendar integration: implement calendar-as-code entries in repo 'launch-calendar' and auto-create events when playbook enters 'Week-0'
Dry-run goals: validate owner handoffs, measure time-to-detect issue, and practice coordinated rollback within 30 minutes
Metrics to monitor: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, tokens/sec, model-side OOMs, infra instance CPU/GPU saturation, ingress queue length
Communications plan: automated Slack channel #launch-gatekeeper for signals + webhook to PagerDuty for Amber/Red escalations
